title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16
source: flac16: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(Maxell UDXL-IIS 90) (lower loge) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > RME PAD 96(A/D conversion) > Apple G4 (Peak editing) > Xact

ai_review.summary: A historically valuable audience recording with a choked‑off Dolby B sound that captures a smoking 1982 show featuring Terrapin, Althea and Peggy‑O.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as a "smokin'" night with strong renditions of Terrapin Station, Althea and a delightful Peggy‑O, and the set even includes a classic Playing in the Band sandwich. The audio source is an audience tape recorded on a Nakamichi Dragon; reviewers note Dolby B encoding quirks, occasional hiss and a "choked off" feel that makes the sound quality range from decent for an audience recording to outright terrible. Overall the show shines despite the mixed technical fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is generally praised with high energy and standout songs, but recording quality is inconsistent and divisive, pulling the overall rating toward the middle of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Dolby B encoded tape played back on a Nakamichi Dragon; reviewers mention a slight "choked off" feeling, hiss, and occasional pocket‑recorder vibe. Some find it decent for an audience source, others deem it terrible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Includes a Playing in the Band sandwich and flows well according to listeners, contributing to an overall high‑energy feel.
